title: APPROVE the project evaluation framework, inclusive of metrics and weighting, for the Measure M 10-Year Comprehensive Assessment (Attachment A).
text:
[Metro Board file 2026-0786, Plan]
[PLANNING AND PROGRAMMING COMMITTEE (4-0) AND EXECUTIVE MANAGEMENT COMMITTEE MADE THE FOLLOWING RECOMMENDATION (3-0):]
APPROVE the project evaluation framework, inclusive of metrics and weighting, for the Measure M 10-Year Comprehensive Assessment (Attachment A).
summary: Metro's board would approve the metrics and weighting framework that will be used to evaluate projects in the Measure M 10-year comprehensive assessment.
